'''Jumara 25 (February 12)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Elayne]]'s first party from [[Caemlyn]] inspects the [[Black Tower]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Daved Hanlon]], under the guise of Doilin Mellar, joins the palace guard in Caemlyn.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Rand]] and [[Min]] return to [[Cairhien]] to collect [[Herid Fel]]'s books. Rand appoints [[Dobraine Taborwin]] as the steward of Cairhien.
*[[1000 NE]] - Rand announces his plan to cleanse the taint on ''[[saidin]]''.
